latest.title: Koog SDK for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory: now generally available
latest.description:
Production AI agents need persistent memory across sessions, multi-tenant isolation, and summarization. 
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory provides this as a managed service. The Koog SDK 1.0.0 brings it natively to Kotlin and Java agents through two opt-in modules: short-term memory backed by AgentCore events, and long-term memory exposed through a Kotlin DSL covering all four AgentCore extraction strategies. trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
